_: The lockfile the kit's privacy audit checks vendored files against. A file here is audited by HASH, not by the personal-data scan: it is somebody else's published release, and what matters about it is that it is byte-identical to what they published. Any file in this folder that is missing from `files`, or whose hash does not match, BLOCKS the build.

pdfjs.why_this_version: Released 2026-07-28, so 32 days old at adoption: past the project's 14-day rule, which applies to the pinned VERSION and not only to the package. It is also the first release carrying the fix for GHSA-hq66-cqwq-w95j (high, published 2026-08-06, arbitrary JavaScript execution on opening a malicious PDF, affecting >= 5.6.83 and < 6.2.108). 6.3.289 was published 2026-08-29 and is one day old, which the rule forbids. The legacy build is vendored rather than the modern one because the devices that reported this defect are an iPad and a phone.
pdfjs.not_vendored: cmaps/ (CJK), standard_fonts/ and wasm/ are left out. The first two matter only for PDFs that do not embed their fonts, and wasm/ only for JPEG2000 and JBIG2 images; all three are binary, which the audit cannot read, and no course material has needed them. A PDF that does will render with substituted fonts rather than fail.
